extractions.description: This paper explores the concept of 'forget-and-relearn' in artificial neural networks, proposing that forgetting can be beneficial to learning. It presents a framework unifying many existing iterative training algorithms, highlighting the role of forgetting in removing undesirable information and enhancing features under varying conditions. By understanding these dynamics, the paper suggests improvements in algorithm performance through targeted forgetting operations, impacting both image classification and language emergence tasks.
